title: Eerie pic of 4ft tall diamond-shaped UFO hovering 200ft over US nuclear plant released as gov ‘baffled’ by sightings
description: A DECLASSIFIED government report has revealed a silent, diamond-shaped UFO hovered just 100 to 200 feet above America's primary nuclear weapons plant. The craft appeared to speed up and change direction when security officers tried to chase it down. The object was picked up by Ground Surveillance Radar at the Pantex Plant near Amarillo, Texas,...
